Name: Name
Skill Registry is a versioned, immutable: Skill Registry is a versioned, immutable catalog for skills imported from approved sources.
A source is connected to Git Manager or: A source is connected to Git Manager or Skill Hub. Sync discovers SKILL.md files and creates candidates. A ready candidate can be published as an immutable version, then downloaded through the public catalog API.
Only SKILL.md is packaged; files such as: Only SKILL.md is packaged; files such as references, models, and binaries are not scanned unless codeFile is declared.
A declared Python or Node entrypoint is: A declared Python or Node entrypoint is validated and included in the artifact.
Enable anonymous access with SKILL_REGIS: Enable anonymous access with SKILL_REGISTRY_PUBLIC_ENABLED=true. These endpoints are read-only and do not require an Authorization header.
list and versions return records in data: list and versions return records in data plus meta.nextCursor. Send the opaque cursor unchanged with the same filters to fetch the next page. limit accepts 1 through 100 and defaults to 20.
download returns a ZIP and the X-Skill-V: download returns a ZIP and the X-Skill-Version, X-Artifact-Sha256, and Digest headers. Hash the downloaded bytes and compare the SHA-256 digest before installing.
Grant registryExportEnabled on the Git M: Grant registryExportEnabled on the Git Manager repository, create a source, run Discover or Sync, resolve blocked candidates, and publish a semantic version. A successful sync does not publish a version automatically.
Versions stays empty until a candidate i: Versions stays empty until a candidate is published. A yanked version is no longer downloadable.
UI values override environment variables: UI values override environment variables and take effect without restarting the app.
Only repositories enabled for registry e: Only repositories enabled for registry export can be selected.
Enter the folder that directly contains: Enter the folder that directly contains skills. If it contains none, the registry also checks its /skills subfolder.
Git repositories could not be loaded. En: Git repositories could not be loaded. Enable Git Manager and grant repository read permission.
An empty skillDefinitionIds list imports: An empty skillDefinitionIds list imports all authorized skill definitions.
Advanced mode saves this JSON exactly as: Advanced mode saves this JSON exactly as entered.
Set includeCompatibility=false on list r: Set includeCompatibility=false on list requests to omit compatibility from each row.
All published versions of the selected s: All published versions of the selected skills will be yanked and removed from the public catalog. Version history and artifacts are retained.
Version audit is an administrative view. Use Manage versions in Catalog for skill-focused install and yank decisions.
This is the final published version. The: This is the final published version. The skill will be removed from the public Catalog and the package will return to draft.
This is the latest stable version. It wi: This is the latest stable version. It will be replaced by {{version}}.
This version will no longer be downloada: This version will no longer be downloadable or installable. Immutable history and artifacts are retained.
